p: my bread for my sacrifices made: By bread he means all manner of sacrifice.
a sacrifice made by fire: The meat offering and drink offering of the evening sacrifice.
tenth deals of flour for a: Of the measure ephah.
continual burnt offering: Which was offered every day at morning and evening.
drink offerings shall be half an: That is, the wine that will be poured on the sacrifice.
weeks be out: In counting seven weeks from the Passover to Whit Sunday, as in Le 23:15.
